summary: Iter 92 — LeaderOS final polish testing. ALL 4 in-scope features pass (backend events scheduling, Stripe checkout, WladUniverse section removal, WladMark asymmetric SVG). FakeWladCall code structure verified (not E2E-testable due to 3-min timer; suppression on /chat verified live). Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass. Frontend: WladMark SVG renders with all required CSS classes (.wlad-mark-w, .wlad-mark-tail, .wlad-mark-pixel-a/b/c) both on /auth login brand panel and in sidebar header. /wlad-universe has wlad-resources section removed (data-testid absent, no 'Originalquellen' or 'Bücher · Podcast · Masterclass' text in DOM), while all other sections (wlad-stats-strip, wlad-5-rollen, wlad-13-topics, wlad-ausbildung, community-cta, hero/ausbildung/closer/roles book-CTAs) render correctly. Zero JS console errors during the flow. FakeWladCall is correctly suppressed on /chat (verified live). Events backend: all 8 live_ki_call_0..7 events fall on weekly Thursdays 2026-07-02→2026-08-20 at 18:00 UTC exactly. POST /api/payments/checkout returns checkout.stripe.com URL (200) for authenticated user (test@test.com).

minor.issue: Requires auth — anonymous POST returns 401. Spec doesn't say anonymous must work, but worth confirming whether unauth checkout from landing page is supported.

critical_code_review_comments: FakeWladCall.js — Clean implementation. SESSION_KEY counter is correctly capped at 2; SUPPRESSED_PATHS rightly includes /chat, /onboarding, /payment-success, /login, /auth/magic. Worth noting: the component does not unmount and reschedules cleanly after navigation; the timer is preserved across route changes (good). Minor: STARTER_PROMPTS only has 2 entries — that matches MAX_CALLS_PER_SESSION=2, so the index math is fine, but a defensive `|| STARTER_PROMPTS[0]` already covers it.

WladMark.js — Nicely structured asymmetric W with hand-tuned path d, drop-shadow ghost for depth, gradient strokes, and 3 pixel accents. Animation hooks (.wlad-mark-w, .wlad-mark-tail) are picked up correctly. The asymmetric heavy right-tail makes the W visually distinguishable from a generic glyph.
WladUniversePage — Cleanly removed wlad-resources section without leaving dead imports or stranded styles. All remaining sections render with correct data-testids.
Events scheduling — _seed_events_v2() cohort_floor migration works: all events on Thursdays >= 2026-07-02. The 8-week live_ki_call_0..7 cadence is exact to spec (2026-07-02..2026-08-20 @ 18:00 UTC).
test_credentials: test@test.com / test123 (works; cookie-based session auth used for /api/payments/checkout)
